response.overview: The prospect of a relationship forces HER, a Black Tomboy in her late 20s, to confront parts of herself she’s kept buried. HER is at a crossroads, torn between embarking on an inward journey of self-discovery and presenting a version of herself that she can no longer sustain. She is riding a fine line between self-love and self-loathing. As HER tries to verbalise her confusion about her sexuality and gender, we see how a religious upbringing and homophobic family members have shaped the way she perceives herself.
response.title: SHAPESHIFTER
